title: Square-zero parameter arrows and transport on isomorphism classes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $k$ a field [def-weil-field] of finite type over $R$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use the marked Artinian test category $\mathcal C_{R,k}$, the square-zero tests $k[V]=k\oplus V$, and groupoid-valued pseudofunctors $\mathcal D$ of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. For finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces $V,W$ [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] and a $k$-linear map $f:V\to W$, define the marked test arrow $k[f]:k[V]\to k[W]$ by $(a,v)\mapsto(a,f(v))$. For every arrow $g:A\to B$ of $\mathcal C_{R,k}$, define transport on isomorphism classes by $\pi_0\mathcal D(g):\pi_0\mathcal D(A)\to\pi_0\mathcal D(B)$, $[x]\mapsto[g_*x]$, using the pseudofunctor transport functor $g_*$. These definitions require neither the predeformation nor the Rim--Schlessinger condition.
